latest_release.name: v0.8.9-rc1
latest_release.body:
https://www.librechat.ai/changelog/v0.8.9-rc1 ## 🏞️ Highlights - Chat Projects with shared instructions and reference files - Passkey sign-in, email changes, and stronger two-factor account protection - Redesigned chat controls, reply notifications, and right-to-left layouts - Deployment themes with configurable colors and appearance - MCP Apps and more deliberate tool-approval choices - Attached-machine enrollment, per-chat workspace choices, attachment copies, and pull request status - Langfuse prompts in the catalog and slash command - Recoverable subagent transcripts and clearer background-task progress - Node.js 24.22.1 security updates and bounded history/tool previews Upgrade guidance: https://www.librechat.ai/docs/configuration/upgrade

Click to expand Release Notes

 ### ✨ Features - ⬆️ feat: Migrate to Zod v4 by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17442](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17442) - 🔎 feat: Filter Agent Builder Selector to Authored Agents by [@berry-13](https://github.com/berry-13) in [#17439](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17439) - 🌿 feat: Branch Tool Fold Rails Into Each Row by [@berry-13](https://github.com/berry-13) in [#17407](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17407) - 🎴 feat: Use Langfuse Prompts from Cards and the Slash Command by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#17104](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17104) - 🏬 feat: Sync Langfuse Prompts into the Catalog by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#17095](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17095) - 🖐️ feat: Make External Prompt Groups Read-Only by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#17008](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17008) - ⛲ feat: Resolve Native and Langfuse Prompts by Source by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#16909](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/16909) - 🏺 feat: Track Prompt Group Source Identity by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#16891](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/16891) - 🧐 feat: Preview Langfuse Prompts in Settings by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#16854](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/16854) - 🪑 feat: Add Shared Source Author and Distributed Lock Helpers by [@AtefBellaaj](https://github.com/AtefBellaaj) in [#17086](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17086) - 🧬 feat: Re-Derive Azure Groups, Vertex AI, Custom Parameters and Spec Defaults for Config Profiles by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17399](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17399) - 🏷️ feat: Hide and Rename Custom Endpoints by Name in Config Profiles by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17396](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17396) - 🧾 feat: Admin Config Write Report, Structured Issues and Deployment-Only Paths by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17395](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17395) - 🔭 feat: Admin Config Read APIs (Resolved and Effective Config, Scope Catalog, Env Status) by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17383](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17383) - 📎 feat: Copy Chat Attachments into Attached Workspaces by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17376](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17376) - 🔐 feat: Admin Config Secrets v2 (MCP and Azure Credentials, Re-entry, Env Allowlist, Rebinding) by [@danny-avila](https://github.com/danny-avila) in [#17353](https://github.com/LibreChat-AI/LibreChat/pull/17353) -
